text.tspan: Generate a collection in the studio
Marcus picks a style and a batch size; the browser posts one request, the core saves recipes, and thumbnails are rendered on demand from those recipes.
Only inputs the chosen style publishes are sent; the toolbar is disabled while creating.
Choose style, color/animal, count, name; press
Loopback host, same origin: route the mutation
A cross-site Origin or a non-loopback Host would have been
refused with 403 before reaching the API.
ResolveInputs: apply the style's defaults and
Fresh cryptographic seeds unless one was supplied;
flock, validate log, refuse duplicate IDs, append,
Render(id, svg): regenerate from the saved
